race.comment: Good little clash between the OTI horses but the leaning is to NEARCO FROD (6) who has won three on the bounce, making the jump from midweek to Saturday grade last time at Flemington, sitting outside a moderate speed and proving far too good. That early pace might see him favoured over THINK GIANT (9) who has been good in two Australian runs to date. He was heavily supported down in the weights last time and just peaked on his run late, up to 2400m third up should suit nicely now. SMOKIN' ROMANS (1) is consistent as ever and did beat home THINK GIANT fair and square when they met. He was solid again last time and is in the mix. BEACH PAD (10) looks ready for 2400m off a good run at Caulfield last time, he'll be running on. TEMPESTI (8) can mix form but isn't hopeless.
